content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * The Royal Palace and Silver Pagoda, constructed in 1866 in Phnom Penh, features a 59-meter Throne Hall and a Silver Pagoda with 5,000 silver tiles. This 2.5-hour experience offers a visual bridge between ancient Angkorian architecture and French colonial urban planning.
> * The Silver Pagoda houses an Emerald Buddha equivalent made of baccarat crystal and a life-sized gold Maitreya Buddha encrusted with nearly 10,000 diamonds. This low-physical-demand tour is best paired with a morning exploring the capital.
> * AGS offers priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers for this year-round experience. Advance booking is strictly required, with a smart casual dress code recommended.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Step inside the resplendent residence of the King of [Cambodia](/destinations/cambodia/), showcasing perfectly manicured gardens, stunning Khmer roofs, and a floor made entirely of silver.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Constructed in 1866 after King Norodom relocated the capital from Oudong to Phnom Penh, the complex serves as the ceremonial heart of the nation. It provides a visual bridge between ancient Angkorian architecture and French colonial urban planning.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Your private historian collects you from your hotel in the morning to beat the intense capital heat. You explore the Throne Hall, topped with a 59-meter tower. 

The highlight is the Silver Pagoda, named for its floor covered with 5,000 gleaming silver tiles. Inside, you witness the legendary Emerald Buddha equivalent (made of baccarat crystal) and a life-sized gold Maitreya Buddha encrusted with nearly 10,000 diamonds. The guide provides essential context on the modern monarchy.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Regal, Historic, Visually Stunning |
| **Duration** | 2.5 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | Low (Easy walking) |
| **Best Paired With** | A morning exploring the capital. |

## Pairing Phnom Penh’s Royal Riverfront With Vattanac & Chhun On Golf Resort
Fronting the Chaktomuk confluence where the Tonle Sap, Upper Mekong, Lower Mekong, and Bassac rivers meet, **The Royal Palace & Silver Pagoda** sits 8 minutes by private SUV from [Raffles Hotel Le Royal](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-hotel-le-royal/) and [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/). On a capital golf itinerary such as [The Khmer Kingdom Links](/tours/the-khmer-kingdom-links/), groups have two seamless ways to experience the palace compound without sacrificing prime turf conditions at [Vattanac Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/vattanac/) or [Chhun On Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/chhun-on-golf-resort/):
1. **Morning Palace & Floodlit Night Golf at Vattanac:** Enter the Royal Palace gates at 08:00 AM with your historian when river breezes cool the courtyards, return to [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/) for lunch, and depart at 2:30 PM for a twilight-into-floodlit round on Sir Nick Faldo’s [Vattanac West Course](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-west/) or [Vattanac East Course](/courses/cambodia/vattanac-east/)—where scale replicas of Angkorian and Pre-Angkorian temples echo the architecture you studied that morning.
2. **Morning 18 Holes & Late-Afternoon Palace Session:** Tee off at 07:30 at [Garden City Golf Club](/courses/cambodia/garden-city/) or [Chhun On Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/chhun-on-golf-resort/), refresh at your hotel, and visit the Silver Pagoda during the calmer 2:30 PM–4:30 PM afternoon opening window before boarding the [Kanika Mekong Sunset Cruise](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-nightlife-sunset-cruise-mekong/).

## Royal Protocol, Attire & Private Scholar Access
* **Strict Royal Compound Dress Code:** Palace guards prohibit sleeveless shirts, shorts above the knee, and open-heel sandals inside the Throne Hall and Silver Pagoda precincts; standard tailored golf trousers or knee-length chinos and a collared polo shirt pass inspection effortlessly.
* **Silver Pagoda Emerald Buddha & French Colonial Context:** Your royal historian traces the architectural dialogue between the 19th-century Khmer roof spires and French protectorate ironwork, connecting the Silver Pagoda’s 5,000 sterling floor tiles directly to the colonial heritage of [Raffles Hotel Le Royal](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-hotel-le-royal/) and the modern skyline view from [Rosewood Phnom Penh](/accommodations/cambodia/rosewood-phnom-penh/).

faqs.q: How can we combine the Royal Palace & Silver Pagoda with golf at Vattanac Golf Resort in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: You can either tour the Royal Palace at 8:00 AM and play a twilight floodlit round at Sir Nick Faldo's Vattanac Golf Resort at 3:00 PM, or play an early 7:30 AM round at Vattanac or Chhun On Golf Resort and visit the palace during its 2:00 PM–5:00 PM afternoon session.

faqs.q: What is the dress code for the Royal Palace and Silver Pagoda in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Shoulders and knees must be covered for both men and women, and hats must be removed inside pagoda sanctuaries. Tailored golf trousers or knee-length shorts paired with a collared polo shirt are ideal.

faqs.q: Why does the Royal Palace Close at midday in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: The Royal Palace compound closes daily between 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM. Asia Golf Specialists times your private historian tour for the 8:00 AM opening or 2:30 PM reopening so you never encounter locked gates or peak heat.
